@ECHO OFF
PUSHD .

SET SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set JAVA_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\java
set JAVAW_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\javaw

CD "%SCRIPT_DIR%\.."
FOR /F %%I IN ('CD') DO SET ROOT_DIR=%%I

FOR /F %%I IN ('TYPE "%ROOT_DIR% in\jarfile"') DO SET PACKAGE_NAME=%%I
set MAIN_CLASS=com.fiberhome.service.TelemetryServiceEntry
echo %MAIN_CLASS%
TITLE %PACKAGE_NAME%
if "%1" neq "" (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -DExtYmlUrl="%1" -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"
) else (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%" 
)
exit
::CALL java -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"

POPD

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

#!/bin/bash -x

# Copyright 2013 OpenStack Foundation

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
# WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the
# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.127.6.15/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.127.6.15/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.127.6.15:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

#!/bin/bash

cd `dirname $0`
echo $(pwd)
cd ..
chmod -R 777 *
export auth_root=$(pwd)
echo $auth_root
echo $UNM_ROOT

source $auth_root/bin/get_properties.sh
mysqlfilepath=$auth_root/config/application-mysql.yml
postgresfilepath=$auth_root/config/application-postgres.yml

ipdefault="127.0.0.1"
if [ -z $DBIP ];then
	  echo "dbip is empty"
	else
    sed -i "s#$ipdefault#$DBIP#g" $mysqlfilepath
    sed -i "s#$ipdefault#$DBIP#g" $postgresfilepath
fi

#!/bin/bash
source /etc/profile
cp -f $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/*.server /etc/init.d/
ln -s $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx  /usr/local/nginx

result=$( cat /etc/SuSE-release | grep "VERSION = 12" )
if [[ "$result" != "" ]] ;then
     version="12"
else
     version="11"
fi
echo $version
if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
  if [[ $dbtype =~ "1" ]] ;then
    cp -f $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/unm2000service/unm2000.service.mysql /usr/lib/systemd/system/unm2000.service
    chmod 777 /usr/lib/systemd/system/unm2000.service
  elif [[ $dbtype =~ "4" ]] ;then
    cp -f $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/unm2000service/unm2000.service.oracle /usr/lib/systemd/system/unm2000.service
    chmod 777 /usr/lib/systemd/system/unm2000.service
  fi
   # cp -f $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/unm2000service/unmtool.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/unmtool.service
   # chmod 777 /usr/lib/systemd/system/unmtool.service
fi

#²é¿´ÏµÍ³°æ±¾
syspath=$(uname -a)
#Èç¹ûÏµÍ³°æ±¾Îªaarch64Ôò°²×°libatomic-7.3.0-20190804.35.p02.ky10.aarch64.rpm
if [[ ${syspath} =~ "aarch64" ]];then
	rpm -ivh "${UNM_ROOT}/platform/bin/libatomic-7.3.0-20190804.35.p02.ky10.aarch64.rpm"
fi

#chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unm.server
chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmstart.server
chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
# chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmtool.server
# chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmtoolstart.server
# chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server
# chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtao.server
cd /etc/init.d

# Éú³ÉÁÙÊ±license
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/platform/bin/unm_license_tryout
$UNM_ROOT/platform/bin/unm_license_tryout --Name unm2000 --Password unm2K10 --UNMRoot $UNM_ROOT
# Éú³ÉÁÙÊ±licenseºóÉ¾³ýlicenseÉú³É¹¤¾ß
if [[ -f "$UNM_ROOT/platform/bin/unm_license_tryout" ]];then
	rm -f "$UNM_ROOT/platform/bin/unm_license_tryout"
fi


if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
systemctl enable unm2000.service
# systemctl enable unmtool.service
else
#chkconfig --add unmtomcat.server
chkconfig --add unmstart.server
# chkconfig --add unmtoolstart.server
fi


#cusa°æ±¾£¬linux°æ±¾Íø¹Ü¹ÜÀí¹¤¾ß·þÎñÆô¶¯
revisionfile=$UNM_ROOT/server/etc/revision.txt
grep "iscusa=true" $revisionfile>>/dev/nul
if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
	if [[ $deploymode -eq 1 || $deploymode -eq 2 ]];then
		sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/configedit/cusamonitorservice/install_cusamonitor_service.sh
	fi
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/sidecar/bin/install_sidecar_service.sh
fi

if [[ $deploymode -eq 1 || $deploymode -eq 2 ]];then
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/scripts/install_nmtool.sh
else
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/install_nmtool_agent.sh
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/set_nmtool_var.sh
fi

# ×¢²ánginx²¢Æô¶¯
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx/script_linux/install_unm_web.sh
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx/script_linux/start_service.sh

#×¢²áË«Òò×Ó·þÎñ
sh $UNM_ROOT/platform/jar/authserver/bin/install_authserver.sh

# export CATALINA_BASE=$UNM_ROOT/jetty
# cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/tomcatserver/*.* $CATALINA_BASE

# cd $CATALINA_BASE

# chmod -R 777 $CATALINA_BASE/install.sh
# chmod -R 777 $CATALINA_BASE/setenv.sh
# chmod -R 777 $CATALINA_BASE/tomcat.service
# chmod -R 777 $CATALINA_BASE/uninstalltomcat.sh
chmod -R 777 $UNM_ROOT/jetty/install.sh
sh $UNM_ROOT/jetty/install.sh
#¿ª»ú×ÔÆô¶¯ TAO

chkconfig unmtao.server on

set UROOT=%~dp0\..\
set CONAN_CHANNEL=stable
@call %~dp0\unmuicore_conan_prepare_u.bat
if not 0==%errorlevel% goto :FINISH
conan build -if conan_gen -sf %UROOT% %UROOT%
if not 0==%errorlevel% goto :FINISH
conan export-pkg -f -sf %UROOT% -bf conan_gen %UROOT% core/stable
if not 0==%errorlevel% goto :FINISH
conan upload -r fiberhome --all unmuicore/2.0.4@core/stable

:FINISH
if A%UNM_NO_PAUSE%==A pause
exit /b %errorlevel%

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Copyright 2017 gRPC authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

set -ex

# cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.."
cd $2

# Install openssl (to use instead of boringssl)
# apt-get update && apt-get install -y libssl-dev
export INSTALL_DIR=$3/install
export OPENSSL_DIR=$6

# 1.46.5 version cannot be compiled by gcc-4.8. by lizhuo
export CC=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/gcc
export CXX=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/g++
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fPIC -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections"
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$2/gcc-4.9.4/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

# Use externally provided env to determine build parallelism, otherwise use default.
# GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS=${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS:-4}

# Install absl
rm -rf "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install c-ares
rm -rf "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCARES_STATIC=ON -DCARES_SHARED=OFF ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install protobuf
rm -rf "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install re2
rm -rf "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install zlib
rm -rf "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Just before installing gRPC, wipe out contents of all the submodules to simulate
# a standalone build from an archive
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
# git submodule foreach 'cd $toplevel; rm -rf $name'

# Install gRPC
rm -rf "cmake/build"
mkdir -p "cmake/build"
pushd "cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" \n  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 \n  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR \n  -DOPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=$OPENSSL_DIR \n  -DZLIB_ROOT=%INSTALL_DIR% \n  -DgRPC_INSTALL=ON \n  -DgRPC_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \n  -DgRPC_ABSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_CARES_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_PROTOBUF_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_RE2_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_SSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_ZLIB_PROVIDER=package \n  ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# # Build helloworld example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/helloworld
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

# # Build route_guide example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/route_guide
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

#current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
#thirdparty_path=$(dirname $(dirname $current_path))/thirdparty
#定时任务是通过cron.service文件执行的，当前目录变更为根目录了，所以这里采取在安装nginx的时候记录nginx的路径
nginx_home=$(cat /usr/nginx_home)
days=7
LOGS_PATH=$nginx_home/logs
 
NEWLOGS_PATH=$LOGS_PATH/history

if [ ! -d "$NEWLOGS_PATH" ];then
	mkdir $NEWLOGS_PATH
fi
 
YESTERDAY=$(date -d "yesterday" +%Y%m%d)
 

mv ${LOGS_PATH}/access.log ${NEWLOGS_PATH}/access_${YESTERDAY}.log
 
/bin/kill -SIGUSR1 $(cat $nginx_home/nginx.pid)

find $NEWLOGS_PATH/ -mtime +$days -delete

#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd -- "$( dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" &> /dev/null && pwd )"


cd $SCRIPT_DIR

NMTOOLS_DIR=$SCRIPT_DIR/..
AGNET_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_agent
SERVICE_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_service
NGINX_DIR=$SERVICE_DIR/thirdparty/nginx
chmod 777 $NMTOOLS_DIR/scripts/chmod_nmtool.sh
sh $NMTOOLS_DIR/scripts/chmod_nmtool.sh

cd $NMTOOLS_DIR
if [ ! -f $NMTOOLS_DIR/unm2000install.ini ];
then 
	echo $NMTOOLS_DIR/unm2000install.ini exist
else 
	echo $NMTOOLS_DIR/unm2000install.ini not exist
fi
cp -R $NMTOOLS_DIR/arm/python $AGNET_DIR
cp -R $NMTOOLS_DIR/arm/nginx $SERVICE_DIR/thirdparty


#注册cmagent服务
cd $AGNET_DIR
sh set_nmtool_var.sh
cd $AGNET_DIR/bin
sh install_nmtool_agent.sh

#注册cmservice服务
cd $SERVICE_DIR/bin
#chmod -R 777 install_nmtool_service.sh
sh install_nmtool_service.sh

#nginx
cd $NGINX_DIR/bin
#chmod -R 777 install_nmtool_webservice.sh
sh install_nmtool_webservice.sh

#开机自启
systemctl daemon-reload

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=('python3_oslo_config' 'python-cipherclient' 'python-licenseclient' 'python-monitorclient' 'python-serviceclient' 'update' 'python3_oslo_messaging')

openEuler_RPM_spec=('recipes-base/python-oslo-config/euler/python3-oslo-config.spec' 'recipes-fitos/python-cipherclient/euler/cipherclient.spec' 'recipes-fitos/licenseclient/euler/licenseclient.spec' 'recipes-fitos/python-monitorclient/euler/monitorclient.spec' 'recipes-fitos/serviceclient/euler/serviceclient.spec' 'recipes-fitos/cgcs-patch/euler/cgcs-patch.spec' 'recipes-base/python-oslo-messaging/euler/python3-oslo-messaging.spec')

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m2


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#Clean up rpmbuild/
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
exit
eeooff

#Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
    do
        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
    done

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

#build openEuler RPMs
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
set -o errexit
cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
rpmbuild -ba *
set +o errexit
exit
eeooff
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
    exit 1
fi

# Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
temp_dir=$1

SOURCE_DIR=unm_cm_service
TARGET_PATH=$SCRIPT_DIR/../$SOURCE_DIR/unm_cm_service_java/unm-cm-distribution/target
#解压之后的位置
THIRDPARTY_PATH=$TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_service/thirdparty
NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH=$THIRDPARTY_PATH/nginx/html/nmtool
TEMP_DIR_PATH=$SCRIPT_DIR/$temp_dir
WEB_DIR=$SCRIPT_DIR/../build_temp_dir/dist/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0


#解压压缩包
unzip -q -o $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip -d $TARGET_PATH
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip

#制作windows压缩包 unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip

#javaservice
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/javaservice.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#jdk1.8.0_171
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/jdk1.8.0_171.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#nginx
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/nginx.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#前端代码
if [ ! -f $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip ];
then
	echo not exit nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	exit -1
else
    echo unzip nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	unzip -q -o $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip -d $NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH
fi


cd  $TARGET_PATH
zip -r -q $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip unm_cm_agent/ unm_cm_service/

#制作linux压缩包
rm -rf $THIRDPARTY_PATH/*
echo copy MySQL_nmtool_linux.zip
echo $TEMP_DIR_PATH/MySQL_nmtool_linux.zip  $THIRDPARTY_PATH/
cp $TEMP_DIR_PATH/MySQL_nmtool_linux.zip  $THIRDPARTY_PATH/
#java
#cp $TEMP_DIR_PATH/openjdk-8u41.tar.gz $THIRDPARTY_PATH

#nginx
tar -xf $TEMP_DIR_PATH/nginx.tar -C $THIRDPARTY_PATH

if [ ! -f $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip ];
then
	echo not exit nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
else
    echo unzip nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	unzip -q -o $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip -d $NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH
fi
zip -r -q $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-linux.zip unm_cm_agent/ unm_cm_service/

#删除相关文件
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_agent/
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_service/

#!/bin/bash
source /etc/profile
cd /etc/init.d

chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

if [ -d "/usr/local/nginx" ];then
rm -r /user/local/nginx
fi

chkconfig --del unmstart.server

chkconfig --del unmtoolstart.server

chkconfig --del passtart.server

#Í£Ö¹·þÎñ

/etc/init.d/unmstop.server
/etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmtao.server stop


$UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

#È¡Ïû¿ª»ú×ÔÆô¶¯
chkconfig -d unmactivemq.server
chkconfig -d unmtao.server
result=$(cat /etc/SuSE-release | grep "VERSION = 12" )
if [[ "$result" != "" ]] ;then
     version="12"
else
     version="11"
fi
if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
    systemctl disable unm2000.service
    systemctl disable unmtool.service 
    # systemctl disable tomcat.service
else
    chkconfig -del unmstart.server
    chkconfig -del unmtoolstart.server
    # chkconfig -del tomcat.service
fi

#cusaÐ¶ÔØ±ß³µ
revisionfile=$UNM_ROOT/server/etc/revision.txt
grep "iscusa=true" $revisionfile>>/dev/nul

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

	fi

	fi
